source_caption_text:
Iggy really came in and did her thing 😮‍💨🔥

Ariana Grande’s “Problem” featuring Iggy Azalea was one of those songs that instantly felt like a huge moment when it came out in 2014. The horn-heavy production, Ariana’s vocals and Iggy’s verse made for a combination you couldn’t really miss.

The song also captured that whole 2014 pop era perfectly. Ariana was coming into her own as a solo artist, while Iggy was everywhere at the time, making their collaboration feel like a perfect snapshot of that moment in music.

More than a decade later, “Problem” still brings back that 2014 nostalgia. The beat, the whistle hook and Iggy’s verse are instantly recognizable, and it remains one of those songs that takes you right back to the era.
